{{Quote|Watch it, you gravel-maggot!" [Anakin] yelled.<br />Beside him his Master, Obi-Wan Kenobi, cleared his throat.<br />"I know, I know ... 'Feel my anger, and let it go.' But do I have to be a Jedi all the time, even in space traffic?|14-year-old Jedi Padawan Anakin Skywalker, piloting a Galan starfighter, fires an expletive at a cruiser pilot cutting in the line waiting to land on the planet Euceron for the [[Galactic Games/Legends|Galactic Games]]|<ref name="Jedi Quest: The Dangerous Games">''[[Jedi Quest: The Dangerous Games]]''</ref>}}
The '''Galan starfighter''' was a sleek, small two-seater [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] used by the [[Galacian]]s.

In [[44 BBY/Legends|44 BBY]], [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Veda (Galacian)|Veda]] of [[Gala]] loaned one of the starfighters to [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]] and his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], who would pilot it during the [[Mission to Melida/Daan]].

More than [[26 BBY/Legends|seventeen years later]], a Galan starfighter was used by Obi-Wan Kenobi and his apprentice [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] on their assignments to [[Euceron]] and [[Haariden]].
